## Summary

Describe the user-visible or contributor-visible outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting, linting, type checking, and relevant durable tests pass.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a long-lived regression test.
- [ ] DataTables integration uses documented public APIs only.
- [ ] Buttons and Select remain optional runtime integrations.
- [ ] No jQuery or third-party UI runtime dependency was introduced.
- [ ] `docs/` contains only public, stable Markdown with the required front matter.
- [ ] No implementation plan, audit, report, scratch file, or external quality-suite
      material is included.
- [ ] Dependency changes use exact stable versions and were checked by the external
      quality suite.
